methodology: North Conway is a village of the Town of Conway, so the races are the Town of Conway's. Districts: RSA 662 (opened at gc.nh.gov) puts all of Carroll County in U.S. House District 1, Conway in Executive Council District 1, State Senate District 3, County Commissioner District 1 and State House district Carroll 1 (Conway alone, 3 seats); the only Carroll floterial-style districts (Carroll 7 and 8) do not include Conway. Candidate lists: Citizens Count's Conway page (Governor, U.S. Senate, U.S. House 1, Executive Council 1, Senate 3, Carroll 1), Ballotpedia race pages (Executive Council, State Senate, Carroll 1, NH-1), The Ballot Brief and GoodParty.org for county offices, and the Conway Daily Sun for 2025 to 2026 county background. Governor and U.S. Senate candidate entries are carried over from Agorri's statewide candidate research (Oct 29, 2026), as are the U.S. House 1 entries; the candidate names and parties were re-confirmed today against Citizens Count's Conway page, but their position sources were not re-opened in this session. Incomplete: (1) The NH Secretary of State 2026 candidate list and Conway sample ballot were not opened (the sos.nh.gov download was blocked by the proxy and no Conway sample ballot link was found); county rosters rest on The Ballot Brief (AI-assisted) and GoodParty.org. (2) Citizens Count candidate profiles for McConkey (2026), Boudman (2026), Colbath, Leonard, Nelson and Corrigan could not be opened; Boudman's quotes come from her 2024 Citizens Count survey and Ballotpedia, McConkey's from his 2024 campaign announcement. (3) Party labels: Stephen Villee is listed as Libertarian in Agorri's other New Hampshire towns but Independent/Other on Citizens Count's Conway page; Sheriff Richardi and Register of Deeds Rines are reported on both party lines. (4) Whether Register of Probate candidate Steve Woodcock is Rep. Stephen Woodcock is not confirmed. (5) Campaign websites for Paige, Leonard, Umberger, McConkey, Boudman and Sinkler could not be opened directly. (6) The 'what' sentence for each office is a general description written for this file, not a quoted source. A statewide constitutional amendment to eliminate the office of Register of Probate is also on the ballot (see county-register-of-probate.related_ballot_measure).
